iss.description: The principal that issued the JWT.

iat.description:
The time the JWT was issued, which is used to determine the age of the JWT.
Provided in seconds in Unix timestamp format.

exp.description:
The expiration time starting from which the JWT must not be accepted for processing.
Provided in seconds in Unix timestamp format.

application_type.description: The type of application. Either `web` or `mobile`.

client_id.description: The Client ID used to identify the application.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description:
Specifies the authentication method for the `/token` endpoint.
Currently, only `tls_client_auth` is supported.

tls_client_auth_dn.description: Distinguished name of the transport certificate used by the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary).

software_statement.description:
Software statement assertion issued by the issuer.

The data model for the software statements issued by the Open Banking directory are documented as part of the Directory Specification.

id_token_signed_response_alg.description: The signing algorithm used to sign the `id_token` JWTs. Currently, only `PS256` is supported.

request_object_signing_alg.description: The signing algorithm used to sign request objects. Currently, only `PS256` is supported.

redirect_uris.description: List of registered URIs that the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary) will use to interact with the [ASPSP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary).

org_jwks_endpoint.description: Public URI endpoint where the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary) has uploaded their JWKS in JSON format.

grant_types.description:
Accepted grant types.
A JSON array specifying what the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary) can request to be supplied to the `/token` endpoint in exchange for an access token.

scope.description: List of scopes that the [TPP](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/guides/build-banking-apps/glossary) has access to, separated by spaces.
